GameConditionDef.label: canyon flood
GameConditionDef.description: The wall has arrived. Red-brown water is tearing through the canyon floor, drowning anything caught below the ledges. It will recede on its own, leaving real soil where the dry cracked clay was.
GameConditionDef.letterText: The chimes were right — the wall has arrived. Water is tearing through the canyon floor.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The floodwater is draining into the cracks. The canyon floor is soil now, where it wasn't before.
